International Conference on "Economic Growth, Social Progress, Environmental Sustainability And Good Governance: In Context Of Viksit Bharat @2047"
Dated: 2026-06-05
As India approaches the centenary of its independence, the nation stands at transformative crossroads. Viksit Bharat 2047 vision is a roadmap to evolve India into a fully developed nation by the year 2047. This ambitious goal rests on four foundational pillars: youth, poor, women, and farmers—the real drivers of India's inclusive growth story.

2 Days Diamond Jubilee Celebration 2024-25
Dated: 2025-11-01
The revised programme for Diamond Jubilee Celebration 2024-25. The programme is rescheduled for 2 days from 01-11-2025 to 02-11-2025.
Diamond Jubilee Celebration
Dated: 2025-11-01
The Diamond Jubilee Celebration Programme will start from 01-10-2025 to 03-10-2025.
One day Workshop on Technical Writing & Reference Management Tools
Dated: 2025-09-19
A Workshop on Technical Writing and Reference Management Tools is organized to help participants strengthen their academic and research writing skills.It is organized by IQAC,Morigaon College (Autonomous).
Prize Money Quiz Competition
Dated: 2025-09-22
Open Prize Money Quiz Competition organised by Morigaon Quiz Forum in collaboration with Lions Club, Morigaon and Morigaon College.
National Seminar on Emerging Trends in AI Research and Applications
Dated: 2025-10-22
The one-day national seminar is organised by the Department of Mathematics and the Department of Computer Applications in collaboration with IQAC, Morigaon College.
Workshop on Professional Development For Non-Technical Staff
Dated: 2025-06-27
This workshop on Professional Development for Non-Teaching Staff is organized with the objective of enhancing their administrative skills, technical knowledge, and overall work place efficiency.
Workshop on “Advantage Assam-2.0 and Scope of UG Colleges in Reshaping the Minds of Youths”
Dated: 2025-06-26
The workshop aims to provide a platform to administration; industrialist & academicians for actively engage in modeling youth with innovative ideas under Advantage Assam-2.0, fostering a transformative learning environment.
